reported.title: Valve deadline uses absolute millis comparison
reported.description: deadlineReached() compares millis() >= valveDeadline with an absolute timestamp, so when millis() wraps (~49.7 days) the valve can stay open indefinitely or close immediately; use a signed elapsed-time comparison instead.

reported.title: Bounce during release can re-trigger a burst
reported.description: The settle logic only requires the raw level to be stable for 12 ms, but a bounce edge during release resets rawChangedAt and the subsequent LOW reading can be accepted as a fresh press once the valve has closed, starting a second burst; the press must be latched until a stable release is confirmed.

truth.description: The close time is stored as an absolute millis() value, so a burst that starts within 400 ms of the 32-bit rollover closes at once

judge_input.spec:
- Spray valve relay on D8; trigger button on D2 with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- A settled press on D2 opens the valve (D8 HIGH) for 400 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- Contact bounce up to 8 ms on press and release must not start a second burst.
- Presses while the valve is open are ignored and do not extend it.
- The valve stays closed (D8 LOW) whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `spray n=<count> open=<0|1>` every 1000 ms.
